description: This file defines the 'Project' class in a SuiteCRM module, including properties for project data, related methods for handling relationships, data retrieval, and custom save logic. It contains class methods for managing project tasks, templates, and relationships, indicating it serves as a core data model for project management within the application.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: The 'Project' class represents a project entity within the SuiteCRM system, handling project data, relationships, and operations such as task management, status determination, and custom save logic, extending the base 'SugarBean' class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Project object, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to fill in additional related detail fields like assigned user name.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to fill in additional list view fields such as assigned user name.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Overrides parent to handle relationship updates, including relinking contacts and users with conditional logic.

methods.name: _get_total_estimated_effort
methods.description: Calculates total estimated effort from related project tasks.

methods.name: _get_total_actual_effort
methods.description: Calculates total actual effort from related project tasks.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the project's name as its summary text.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a SQL WHERE clause for searching projects based on a query string.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data array for list views, including assigned user name.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates interface implementations, such as ACL.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL query for exporting project data, optionally filtering and ordering.

methods.name: getAllProjectTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all non-deleted tasks related to this project.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Gets the default status value for the project.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Custom save method that manages project template copying, resource relationships, and related task creation based on templates.
